config.install.title: Faz AI: Installation
config.install.environment: The Environment Diagnostics shows what the board needs on this machine, why, and how to fix it, with one-click install. [Open the Environment Diagnostics](command:fazai.openEnvironment)
config.appearance.title: Faz AI: Appearance
config.appearance.language: Language of the board interface. `auto` follows the editor language. Theme, font and font size are the neighboring settings in this same section; card status labels and colors are still edited on the board (Workflows tab).
config.appearance.theme: Theme of the board interface. `system` follows the editor's light or dark theme (or the operating system's, in the browser); the board's colors are always the same.
config.appearance.theme.system: System (follows the editor or the operating system)
config.appearance.font: Font used in long text fields (description, conversation) on the board.
config.appearance.fontSize: Size, in px, of the font used in long text fields on the board.
config.git.title: Faz AI: Git
config.git.mode: Where the AI works on the code of each story.
config.git.mode.worktree: Each story gets its own branch and working folder. The AI works on the code there, without touching your folder or your work in progress.
config.git.mode.branch: Each story gets its own branch, but the work happens in the project folder: the AI switches branches in it. Avoid this with the heartbeat on, because it can run over what you are doing.
config.git.mode.off: The board does not create branches or worktrees.
config.git.branchPattern: Branch name for each story. Accepts `{tipo}`, `{numero}` (required) and `{titulo}`. Only applies when [Where the AI works on the code](@id:fazai.git.mode) is not `off`.
config.git.worktreeDir: Folder where the worktrees live, relative to the project folder; `{repo}` is its name. Only applies in `worktree` mode ([Where the AI works on the code](@id:fazai.git.mode)).
config.git.parallel: With the heartbeat on, drives several stories with a branch (Implementation, Homologation) at the same time, each in its own worktree. Only applies in `worktree` mode; text-only phases (refine, summarize, Discovery, PRD, Spec, Plan) run in parallel in any mode ([Where the AI works on the code](@id:fazai.git.mode)). [Open the heartbeat, under AI Harness](command:fazai.openBoardSettings?%7B%22tab%22%3A%22harness%22%2C%22section%22%3A%22heartbeat%22%7D).
config.git.parallelStories: How many stories at the same time, at least two. Caps text-only phases in any mode, and branch phases only with [Drive stories in parallel](@id:fazai.git.parallel) on, in `worktree` mode; the two caps are counted separately.
config.git.autoMerge: When you approve the story in the last column before done, merges its pull request and completes the card. The merge is done on GitHub with your account (`gh` command) and cannot be undone by the board.
config.git.mergeMethod: Merge type for the pull request. Only applies with [auto-merge](@id:fazai.git.autoMerge) on.
config.git.watchMerges: Completes the story on its own when its pull request is merged outside the board.
config.git.watchMergeMinutes: Interval between checks of the pull requests' state, in minutes. Only applies with [watch merges](@id:fazai.git.watchMerges) on.
config.backup.title: Faz AI: Backup
config.backup.info: Back up or restore the whole board: cards, conversations, attachments and settings. [Export the board now](command:fazai.exportBoard) | [Import a board](command:fazai.importBoard).
